amazon_basin.name: Amazon Rainforest & Pantanal Basin
amazon_basin.description: Tropical forest deforestation, drought-driven megafires, and savanna-forest ecotone burning across South America.

historical_events.event: Unprecedented South American Drought & Fire Spike

california_western_us.name: California & Western United States
california_western_us.description: Mediterranean chaparral, Sierra Nevada coniferous forests, extreme Santa Ana and Diablo wind-driven wildfire complexes.

historical_events.event: Record Fire Season (August Complex >1M acres, 4.3M total acres)

australia_southeast.name: Southeast Australia Bushfire Belt
australia_southeast.description: Temperate eucalyptus forests, drought-induced extreme pyroconvection, and severe heatwave fire weather.

historical_events.event: Black Summer Climax (>24M hectares burned nationally)

indo_gangetic_plain.name: Indo-Gangetic Plain (Punjab / Haryana)
indo_gangetic_plain.description: Intense post-monsoon agricultural crop residue burning (paddy stubble) characterized by dense sub-pixel thermal anomalies.

canada_boreal.name: Canadian Boreal & Taiga
canada_boreal.description: Deep peat and boreal spruce/pine forest burning with intercontinental smoke transport and high radiative energy.

historical_events.event: Historic Wildfire Disaster (>18.4M hectares, 5% of Canadian forests burned)

mediterranean_basin.name: Southern Europe & Mediterranean Basin
mediterranean_basin.description: Summer heatwaves, drought-stressed maquis and pine woodlands across Mediterranean coastlines.

historical_events.event: Alexandroupoli Fire (Largest recorded in EU history)

african_savanna.name: Central & Southern African Savannas
african_savanna.description: Vast dry-season savanna burning pulse accounting for a substantial fraction of global annual burned area.
